newsitem.title: USA: Norwalk, Iowa, bond winner not yet determined.
newsitem.headline: Norwalk, Iowa, bond winner not yet determined.

text.p: A $1.25 million Norwalk, Iowa, general obligation bond deal, apparently won by Dain Bosworth Thursday, may not be awarded to the firm, the deal's financial adviser said.
Dain's winning net interest cost bid of 4.87 percent was not in compliance with bidding rules, but may be accepted anyway, the adviser said. A decision will be made later Thursday.
The only other bidder was Harris Trust and Saving Bank, with a bid of 4.99 percent.
